This is direct evidence of political imprisonment and exemplary punishment under Xi’s system.","question_ids":["3B.2","3B.1"]},{"title":"China: Activist Li Qiaochu unjustly convicted ‘for speaking out about torture’","publisher":"Amnesty International","date":"2024-02-05","url":"https://www.amnesty.org/en/latest/news/2024/02/china-activist-li-qiaochu-unjustly-convicted-for-speaking-out-about-torture/","summary":"Amnesty says Li Qiaochu was punished after describing torture and ill-treatment in detention. That points to retaliation for exposing abuse, not protection from it.","question_ids":["3B.2","3B.1"]},{"title":"China: Free Jailed Tiananmen Participants, Supporters, and Advocates for Justice","publisher":"Chinese Human Rights Defenders","date":"2024-05-31","url":"https://www.nchrd.org/2024/05/china-free-jailed-tiananmen-participants-supporters-and-advocates-for-justice/","summary":"CHRD said multiple Tiananmen participants and supporters remained imprisoned in 2024, showing ongoing political imprisonment and no meaningful protection from arbitrary punitive detention.","question_ids":["3B.2","3B.1"]}]}
